title: Cloudflare Warp
description: A Fabric mod that routes all Minecraft server connections through an encrypted WireGuard/Cloudflare WARP tunnel, hiding your real IP and securing your traffic.
body:
# WireGuard Tunnel

A Fabric mod that tunnels Minecraft server connections through WireGuard/WARP, providing encrypted and private networking for your gameplay.

## Features

- **Privacy**: Your real IP is hidden from servers
- **Security**: All traffic is encrypted through Cloudflare WARP
- **Bypass**: Can help bypass certain network restrictions
- Automatic WARP credential generation and management
- Cross-platform support (Linux, Windows, macOS - x86_64 and aarch64)
- Seamless integration with Minecraft's networking stack

## How It Works

The mod uses a native Rust library to create a userspace WireGuard tunnel using Cloudflare WARP. When you connect to a Minecraft server, the connection is automatically routed through this encrypted tunnel.
